I'm Nandini, and I'm the only person from Manipur in my college hostel in Pune. In my first month, people asked if I ate dogs, if I was from China, if I could speak "Indian".

Irawati, my roommate, changed things. She didn't ask me to explain anything. She asked what books I liked, whether I wanted chai, what I thought about our professor.
Slowly, others started talking to me that way too.
Now, most days, I'm just Nandini. Not a representative. Just a girl who likes rain and poetry.
